    <!DOCTYPE html>
    <html lang="ko">
    <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8"/>
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no"/>
    <title>🦕 공룡 에이트</title>
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"/>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Noto+Sans+KR:wght@300;400;500;700&family=Noto+Serif+KR:wght@400;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
    <style>
    :root {
    --green: #2d5a3d;
    --green2: #3d7a55;
    --accent: #5a9e72;
    --egg: #f5e97a;
    --bg: #f3f6f0;
    --cream: #faf9f5;
    --white: #ffffff;
    --text: #1e2d22;
    --muted: #6b8572;
    --border: #d8e6dc;
    /* 4부호 컬러 */
    --bang: #f59e0b; /* ! 느낌표 */
    --quote: #8b5cf6; /* " 따옴표 */
    --qmark: #3b82f6; /* ? 물음표 */
    --apply: #ec4899; /* @ 적용 */
    --bang-bg: #fffbeb;
    --quote-bg:#f5f3ff;
    --qmark-bg:#eff6ff;
    --apply-bg:#fdf2f8;
    }
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
    body {
    font-family: 'Noto Sans KR', sans-serif;
    background: var(--bg);
    color: var(--text);
    max-width: 480px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    min-height: 100vh;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    }
    /* ── 화면 ─────────────────────────────── */
    .screen { display: none; min-height: 100vh; padding-bottom: 80px; }
    .screen.on { display: block; }
    /* ── 탑바 ─────────────────────────────── */
    .topbar {
    position: sticky; top: 0;
    background: var(--white);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    padding: 13px 16px;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
    z-index: 50;
    }
    .topbar-title {
    font-family: 'Noto Serif KR', serif;
    font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--green);
    }
    .topbar-actions { display: flex; gap: 6px; }
    /* ── 하단 네비 ────────────────────────── */
    .bottom-nav {
    position: fixed; bottom: 0; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
    width: 100%; max-width: 480px;
    background: var(--white); border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    display: flex; z-index: 100;
    padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom);
    }
    .nav-item {
    flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center; padding: 10px 4px 8px;
    border: none; background: none; cursor: pointer;
    font-family: inherit; gap: 2px; color: var(--muted); transition: color .15s;
    }
    .nav-item.active { color: var(--green); }
    .nav-item .ni { font-size: 19px; }
    .nav-item .nl { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; }
    .nav-add {
    flex: 1; display: flex; align-items: center;
    justify-content: center; border: none; background: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 8px;
    }
    .add-c {
    width: 48px; height: 48px;
    background: var(--green); border-radius: 50%;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    font-size: 22px; color: white; margin-top: -18px;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(45,90,61,.4);
    }
    /* ── 패딩 ─────────────────────────────── */
    .sp { padding: 14px 14px 0; }
    /* ── 카드 ─────────────────────────────── */
    .card {
    background: var(--white); border-radius: 16px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border); padding: 16px; margin-bottom: 10px;
    }
    /* ── 버튼 ─────────────────────────────── */
    .btn {
    width: 100%; padding: 13px; border: none; border-radius: 10px;
    font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer;
    font-family: inherit; transition: opacity .15s;
    }
    .btn:hover { opacity: .85; }
    .btn:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed; }
    .btn-green { background: var(--green); color: white; }
    .btn-ghost { background: var(--white); color: var(--text); border: 1px solid var(--border); }
    .btn-sm {
    padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 11px; width: auto; border-radius: 8px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--white); color: var(--text);
    font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit;
    }
    .btn-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; }
    .btn-row .btn { flex: 1; }
    /* ── 폼 ──────────────────────────────── */
    .fg { margin-bottom: 12px; }
    .fg label { display: block; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 4px; }
    .fg input, .fg textarea, .fg select {
    width: 100%; padding: 10px 12px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px;
    font-size: 14px; font-family: inherit; color: var(--text);
    outline: none; transition: border-color .15s; background: var(--white);
    }
    .fg input:focus, .fg textarea:focus, .fg select:focus { border-color: var(--accent); }
    .fg textarea { resize: vertical; min-height: 80px; line-height: 1.7; }
    /* ── D-day 카드 ───────────────────────── */
    .dday-card {
    background: var(--green); color: white;
    border-radius: 16px; padding: 18px 20px;
    margin-bottom: 10px; position: relative; overflow: hidden;
    }
    .dday-dino { position: absolute; right: 14px; bottom: 0; font-size: 48px; opacity: .18; }
    .dday-label { font-size: 11px; opacity: .7; margin-bottom: 3px; }
    .dday-num { font-family: 'Noto Serif KR', serif; font-size: 40px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; }
    .dday-date { font-size: 12px; opacity: .75; margin-top: 5px; }
    /* ── 책 카드 ──────────────────────────── */
    .book-card {
    background: var(--white); border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px; margin-bottom: 10px;
    display: flex; gap: 14px; align-items: flex-start;
    }
    .book-cover {
    width: 64px; height: 90px; object-fit: cover;
    border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border); flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .book-cover-ph {
    width: 64px; height: 90px; border-radius: 6px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border); flex-shrink: 0;
    background: var(--bg); display: flex; align-items: center;
    justify-content: center; font-size: 26px;
    }
    .book-title { font-family: 'Noto Serif KR', serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--green); margin-bottom: 3px; }
    .book-author { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 5px; }
    /* ── 섹션 레이블 ──────────────────────── */
    .section-label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--green); margin: 6px 0 8px; }
    .section-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 8px; }
    /* ── 한마디 ───────────────────────────── */
    .oneliner-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 7px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
    .oneliner-card {
    background: var(--white); border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 12px; padding: 11px;
    }
    .ol-name { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--green); margin-bottom: 4px; }
    .ol-text { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text); line-height: 1.6; }
    .ol-empty { font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); font-style: italic; }
    /* ── 4부호 배지 ───────────────────────── */
    .sym-badge {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px;
    padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700;
    }
    .sym-bang { background: var(--bang-bg); color: var(--bang); }
    .sym-quote { background: var(--quote-bg); color: var(--quote); }
    .sym-qmark { background: var(--qmark-bg); color: var(--qmark); }
    .sym-apply { background: var(--apply-bg); color: var(--apply); }
    /* ── 4부호 탭 필터 ────────────────────── */
    .filter-row {
    display: flex; gap: 6px; overflow-x: auto;
    padding: 0 0 8px; scrollbar-width: none; margin-bottom: 4px;
    }
    .filter-row::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
    .ftab {
    flex-shrink: 0; padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700;
    border: 1.5px solid var(--border); background: var(--white); color: var(--muted);
    cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit; transition: all .15s;
    }
    .ftab.active { background: var(--green); color: white; border-color: var(--green); }
    /* ── 구절 카드 ────────────────────────── */
    .sc {
    background: var(--white); border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px; margin-bottom: 10px;
    }
    .sc.sym-bang-card { border-left: 3px solid var(--bang); }
    .sc.sym-quote-card { border-left: 3px solid var(--quote); }
    .sc.sym-qmark-card { border-left: 3px solid var(--qmark); }
    .sc.sym-apply-card { border-left: 3px solid var(--apply); }
    .sc-hd { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
    .avatar {
    width: 32px; height: 32px; background: var(--green);
    border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center;
    justify-content: center; color: white; font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 700; flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .sc-name { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--green); }
    .sc-date { font-size: 10px; color: var(--muted); }
    .sc-sent {
    font-family: 'Noto Serif KR', serif; font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 1.85; color: var(--text);
    border-left: 3px solid var(--accent);
    padding-left: 12px; margin-bottom: 7px;
    }
    .sc-pg { font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 7px; }
    .sc-ft { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; }
    .sc-badges { display: flex; gap: 4px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
    /* ── 댓글 버튼 ────────────────────────── */
    .cmt-btn {
    background: none; border: none; font-size: 12px;
    color: var(--muted); cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit;
    padding: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px;
    }
    .cmt-btn:hover { color: var(--green); }
    /* ── 댓글 글타래 (인라인) ─────────────── */
    .cmt-thread {
    margin-top: 10px; padding-top: 10px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .cmt-item {
    padding: 8px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #f0f4f1;
    }
    .cmt-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
    .cmt-hd { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 3px; }
    .cmt-av {
    width: 24px; height: 24px; background: var(--accent);
    border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center;
    justify-content: center; color: white; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .cmt-author { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--green); }
    .cmt-time { font-size: 10px; color: var(--muted); }
    .cmt-text { font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.6; padding-left: 30px; }
    .cmt-reply-btn {
    background: none; border: none; font-size: 10px; color: var(--muted);
    cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit; padding: 2px 0 0 30px;
    }
    .cmt-reply-btn:hover { color: var(--green); }
    /* 대댓글 */
    .reply-item {
    margin-left: 24px; margin-top: 6px;
    padding: 7px 10px; background: var(--bg);
    border-radius: 10px; border-left: 2px solid var(--border);
    }
    .reply-hd { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; margin-bottom: 3px; }
    .reply-av {
    width: 20px; height: 20px; background: var(--green2);
    border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center;
    justify-content: center; color: white; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .reply-author { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--green); }
    .reply-time { font-size: 10px; color: var(--muted); }
    .reply-text { font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--text); }
    /* 댓글 입력 */
    .cmt-input-row {
    display: flex; gap: 7px; margin-top: 10px; align-items: flex-end;
    }
    .cmt-input-row select {
    padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px;
    font-size: 12px; font-family: inherit; color: var(--text);
    background: var(--white); outline: none; flex-shrink: 0; width: 90px;
    }
    .cmt-input-row input {
    flex: 1; padding: 8px 12px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 20px;
    font-size: 13px; font-family: inherit; outline: none;
    }
    .cmt-input-row input:focus { border-color: var(--accent); }
    .cmt-send {
    background: var(--green); color: white; border: none;
    border-radius: 50%; width: 36px; height: 36px;
    font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    /* 대댓글 입력폼 */
    .reply-form {
    display: flex; gap: 6px; margin: 6px 0 0 24px; align-items: center;
    }
    .reply-form select {
    padding: 6px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px;
    font-size: 11px; font-family: inherit; color: var(--text);
    background: var(--white); outline: none; flex-shrink: 0; width: 80px;
    }
    .reply-form input {
    flex: 1; padding: 6px 10px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 16px;
    font-size: 12px; font-family: inherit; outline: none;
    }
    .reply-form input:focus { border-color: var(--accent); }
    .reply-send {
    background: var(--accent); color: white; border: none;
    border-radius: 50%; width: 30px; height: 30px;
    font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    /* ── 모임 준비 화면 ───────────────────── */
    .prep-symbol {
    border-radius: 16px; padding: 14px; margin-bottom: 10px;
    border: 1.5px solid;
    }
    .prep-symbol.bang { border-color: var(--bang); background: var(--bang-bg); }
    .prep-symbol.quote { border-color: var(--quote); background: var(--quote-bg); }
    .prep-symbol.qmark { border-color: var(--qmark); background: var(--qmark-bg); }
    .prep-symbol.apply { border-color: var(--apply); background: var(--apply-bg); }
    .prep-sym-hd { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
    .prep-sym-icon { font-size: 20px; }
    .prep-sym-title { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; }
    .prep-sym-desc { font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 1px; }
    .prep-sym-hd .bang-c { color: var(--bang); }
    .prep-sym-hd .quote-c { color: var(--quote); }
    .prep-sym-hd .qmark-c { color: var(--qmark); }
    .prep-sym-hd .apply-c { color: var(--apply); }
    .prep-cards { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
    .prep-card {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,.7); border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 10px 12px; display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 8px;
    }
    .prep-card-avatar {
    width: 26px; height: 26px; background: var(--green);
    border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center;
    justify-content: center; color: white; font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 700; flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 1px;
    }
    .prep-card-name { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--green); margin-bottom: 3px; }
    .prep-card-text { font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.65; color: var(--text); }
    .prep-empty { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); text-align: center; padding: 12px 0; }
    .prep-add-btn {
    width: 100%; padding: 9px; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700;
    border: 1.5px dashed; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit;
    margin-top: 6px;
    }
    .prep-add-btn.bang { border-color: var(--bang); color: var(--bang); }
    .prep-add-btn.quote { border-color: var(--quote); color: var(--quote); }
    .prep-add-btn.qmark { border-color: var(--qmark); color: var(--qmark); }
    .prep-add-btn.apply { border-color: var(--apply); color: var(--apply); }
    /* ── 레퍼런스 ─────────────────────────── */
    .ref-card {
    background: var(--white); border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 14px; padding: 13px 14px; margin-bottom: 9px;
    display: flex; gap: 11px; align-items: flex-start;
    text-decoration: none; color: inherit;
    }
    .ref-type { font-size: 20px; flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 2px; }
    .ref-title { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--green); margin-bottom: 2px; }
    .ref-meta { font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); }
    /* ── 아카이브 ─────────────────────────── */
    .arch-card {
    background: var(--white); border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 14px; padding: 13px 14px; margin-bottom: 9px;
    display: flex; gap: 11px; align-items: center;
    }
    .arch-month {
    background: var(--green); color: white;
    border-radius: 8px; padding: 5px 9px;
    font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; text-align: center;
    flex-shrink: 0; min-width: 44px;
    }
    /* ── 모달 (바텀시트) ──────────────────── */
    .ov {
    display: none; position: fixed; inset: 0;
    background: rgba(0,0,0,.45); z-index: 200;
    align-items: flex-end; justify-content: center;
    }
    .ov.on { display: flex; }
    .msheet {
    background: var(--white); border-radius: 20px 20px 0 0;
    padding: 20px; width: 100%; max-width: 480px;
    max-height: 88vh; overflow-y: auto;
    animation: slideUp .22s ease;
    }
    @keyframes slideUp { from { transform: translateY(100%); } to { transform: translateY(0); } }
    .mhandle { width: 34px; height: 4px; background: var(--border); border-radius: 2px; margin: 0 auto 16px; }
    .mtitle { font-family: 'Noto Serif KR', serif; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--green); margin-bottom: 14px; }
    /* ── 태그 선택 ────────────────────────── */
    .sym-select-row { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; margin-top: 4px; }
    .sym-select-item {
    display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px; border: 1.5px solid var(--border);
    background: var(--white); cursor: pointer; transition: all .15s;
    font-family: inherit; text-align: left; width: 100%;
    }
    .sym-select-item.sel-bang { border-color: var(--bang); background: var(--bang-bg); }
    .sym-select-item.sel-quote { border-color: var(--quote); background: var(--quote-bg); }
    .sym-select-item.sel-qmark { border-color: var(--qmark); background: var(--qmark-bg); }
    .sym-select-item.sel-apply { border-color: var(--apply); background: var(--apply-bg); }
    .sym-select-icon { font-size: 18px; flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 1px; }
    .sym-select-name { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; }
    .sym-select-desc { font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 1px; line-height: 1.5; }
    .sym-select-name.bang-c { color: var(--bang); }
    .sym-select-name.quote-c { color: var(--quote); }
    .sym-select-name.qmark-c { color: var(--qmark); }
    .sym-select-name.apply-c { color: var(--apply); }
    /* ── 기타 ─────────────────────────────── */
    .empty { text-align: center; padding: 48px 24px; color: var(--muted); }
    .ei { font-size: 38px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
    .alert { padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
    .ae { background: #fee2e2; color: #991b1b; }
    .ao { background: #dcfce7; color: #166534; }
    .spin {
    display: inline-block; width: 13px; height: 13px;
    border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3); border-top-color: white;
    border-radius: 50%; animation: rot .6s linear infinite; vertical-align: middle; margin-right: 4px;
    }
    @keyframes rot { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
    .divider { height: 1px; background: var(--border); margin: 10px 0; }
    </style>
    </head>
    <body>
    <div id="appWrap">
    <!-- ── 홈 ── -->
    <div class="screen on" id="scHome">
    <div class="topbar">
    <div class="topbar-title">🦕 공룡 에이트</div>
    <div class="topbar-actions">
    <button class="btn-sm" onclick="openOv('meetingOv')">📅 모임</button>
    <button class="btn-sm" onclick="openOv('bookOv')">📖 책</button>
    </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sp">
    <div class="dday-card" id="ddayCard">
    <div class="dday-dino">🦕</div>
    <div class="dday-label">다음 모임까지</div>
    <div class="dday-num" id="ddayNum">-</div>
    <div class="dday-date" id="ddayDate">모임 날짜를 설정해주세요</div>
    </div>
    <div id="bookArea">
    <div class="card" style="text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;padding:20px">
    🦕 이달의 책을 설정해주세요
    </div>
    </div>
    <div class="section-row">
    <div class="section-label" style="margin:0">💬 이달의 한마디</div>
    <button class="btn-sm" onclick="openOnelineModal()">+ 남기기</button>
    </div>
    <div class="oneliner-grid" id="onelineGrid"></div>
    </div>
    </div>
    <!-- ── 구절 ── -->
    <div class="screen" id="scSent">
    <div class="topbar">
    <div class="topbar-title">💬 구절 나누기</div>
    </div>
    <div class="sp">
    <div class="filter-row" id="sentFilter">
    <button class="ftab active" data-f="all" onclick="filterSent('all',this)">전체</button>
    <button class="ftab" data-f="!" onclick="filterSent('!',this)">❗ 느낌표</button>
    <button class="ftab" data-f='"' onclick="filterSent('"',this)">" 따옴표</button>
    <button class="ftab" data-f="?" onclick="filterSent('?',this)">? 물음표</button>
    <button class="ftab" data-f="@" onclick="filterSent('@',this)">@ 적용</button>
    </div>
    <div id="sentList">
    <div class="empty"><div class="ei">🦕</div>아직 공유된 구절이 없어요</div>
    </div>
    </div>
    </div>
    <!-- ── 모임 준비 ── -->
    <div class="screen" id="scPrep">
    <div class="topbar">
    <div class="topbar-title">📋 모임 준비</div>
    </div>
    <div class="sp">
    <div class="card" style="margin-bottom:12px;padding:12px 14px">
    <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.7">
    모임 전, 4가지 부호로 읽은 내용을 미리 정리해보세요.<br>
    모임 때 함께 나눌 이야기의 씨앗이 됩니다 🌱
    </div>
    </div>
    <div id="prepContent"></div>
    </div>
    </div>
    <!-- ── 레퍼런스 ── -->
    <div class="screen" id="scRef">
    <div class="topbar"><div class="topbar-title">📎 레퍼런스</div></div>
    <div class="sp" id="refList">
    <div class="empty"><div class="ei">📎</div>아직 레퍼런스가 없어요</div>
    </div>
    </div>
    <!-- ── 아카이브 ── -->
    <div class="screen" id="scArch">
    <div class="topbar"><div class="topbar-title">📚 아카이브</div></div>
    <div class="sp" id="archList">
    <div class="empty"><div class="ei">📚</div>아직 아카이브가 없어요</div>
    </div>
    </div>
    <!-- 하단 네비 -->
    <nav class="bottom-nav">
    <button class="nav-item active" data-sc="Home" onclick="goTab('Home')">
    <span class="ni">🏠</span><span class="nl">홈</span>
    </button>
    <button class="nav-item" data-sc="Sent" onclick="goTab('Sent')">
    <span class="ni">💬</span><span class="nl">구절</span>
    </button>
    <button class="nav-add" onclick="openFAB()">
    <div class="add-c">🦕</div>
    </button>
    <button class="nav-item" data-sc="Prep" onclick="goTab('Prep')">
    <span class="ni">📋</span><span class="nl">모임준비</span>
    </button>
    <button class="nav-item" data-sc="Arch" onclick="goTab('Arch')">
    <span class="ni">📚</span><span class="nl">아카이브</span>
    </button>
    </nav>
    </div>
    <!-- ══ 모달: 책 설정 ══ -->
    <div class="ov" id="bookOv">
    <div class="msheet">
    <div class="mhandle"></div>
    <div class="mtitle">📖 이달의 책 설정</div>
    <div id="bookAlert"></div>
    <div class="fg"><label>제목 *</label><input id="bkTitle" type="text" placeholder="책 제목"/></div>
    <div class="fg"><label>저자</label><input id="bkAuthor" type="text" placeholder="저자명"/></div>
    <div class="fg"><label>출판사</label><input id="bkPub" type="text" placeholder="출판사"/></div>
    <div class="fg"><label>정가</label><input id="bkPrice" type="text" placeholder="예: 17,000원"/></div>
    <div class="fg"><label>표지 URL</label><input id="bkCover" type="url" placeholder="https://..."/></div>
    <div class="fg"><label>책 소개</label><textarea id="bkIntro" placeholder="짧은 소개" rows="3"></textarea></div>
    <div class="fg"><label>책 정보 링크</label><input id="bkLink" type="url" placeholder="https://..."/></div>
    <div class="btn-row">
    <button class="btn btn-ghost" onclick="closeOv('bookOv')">취소</button>
    <button class="btn btn-green" id="bookSaveBtn" onclick="saveBook()">저장</button>
    </div>
    </div>
    </div>
    <!-- ══ 모달: 모임 설정 ══ -->
    <div class="ov" id="meetingOv">
    <div class="msheet">
    <div class="mhandle"></div>
    <div class="mtitle">📅 다음 모임 설정</div>
    <div id="meetingAlert"></div>
    <div class="fg"><label>모임 날짜</label><input id="mtDate" type="date"/></div>
    <div class="fg"><label>장소 (선택)</label><input id="mtLoc" type="text" placeholder="장소 입력"/></div>
    <div class="fg"><label>메모 (선택)</label><input id="mtNote" type="text" placeholder="메모"/></div>
    <div class="btn-row">
    <button class="btn btn-ghost" onclick="closeOv('meetingOv')">취소</button>
    <button class="btn btn-green" id="meetingSaveBtn" onclick="saveMeeting()">저장</button>
    </div>
    </div>
    </div>
    <!-- ══ 모달: 한마디 ══ -->
    <div class="ov" id="onelineOv">
    <div class="msheet">
    <div class="mhandle"></div>
    <div class="mtitle">💬 이달의 한마디</div>
    <div id="olAlert"></div>
    <div class="fg"><label>이름</label>
    <select id="olName"><option value="">이름 선택</option></select></div>
    <div class="fg"><label>한마디</label>
    <textarea id="olText" placeholder="이번 달 책에 대한 한마디를 남겨주세요" rows="3"></textarea></div>
    <div class="btn-row">
    <button class="btn btn-ghost" onclick="closeOv('onelineOv')">취소</button>
    <button class="btn btn-green" id="olBtn" onclick="submitOneline()">등록</button>
    </div>
    </div>
    </div>
    <!-- ══ 모달: 구절 올리기 ══ -->
    <div class="ov" id="sentOv">
    <div class="msheet">
    <div class="mhandle"></div>
    <div class="mtitle">🦕 구절 올리기</div>
    <div id="sentAlert"></div>
    <div class="fg"><label>이름</label>
    <select id="stName"><option value="">이름 선택</option></select></div>
    <div class="fg"><label>구절</label>
    <textarea id="stText" placeholder="마음에 걸린 문장을 적어주세요" rows="4"></textarea></div>
    <div class="fg"><label>페이지 (선택)</label>
    <input type="number" id="stPage" placeholder="예: 47"/></div>
    <div class="fg">
    <label>부호 선택 (하나 또는 여러 개)</label>
    <div class="sym-select-row">
    <button type="button" class="sym-select-item" data-t="!" onclick="toggleSym(this)">
    <span class="sym-select-icon">❗</span>
    <div>
    <div class="sym-select-name bang-c">! 느낌표</div>
    <div class="sym-select-desc">책을 처음 접하고 느낀 점 — 표지나 제목, 첫인상을 가볍게</div>
    </div>
    </button>
    <button type="button" class="sym-select-item" data-t='"' onclick="toggleSym(this)">
    <span class="sym-select-icon">💬</span>
    <div>
    <div class="sym-select-name quote-c">" " 따옴표</div>
    <div class="sym-select-desc">인용하고 싶은 문장 — 읽으며 좋았던, 인사이트가 있었던 문장</div>
    </div>
    </button>
    <button type="button" class="sym-select-item" data-t="?" onclick="toggleSym(this)">
    <span class="sym-select-icon">❓</span>
    <div>
    <div class="sym-select-name qmark-c">? 물음표</div>
    <div class="sym-select-desc">읽으며 궁금했던 문장 — 몰라서, 의아해서, 질문이 생긴 것</div>
    </div>
    </button>
    <button type="button" class="sym-select-item" data-t="@" onclick="toggleSym(this)">
    <span class="sym-select-icon">✨</span>
    <div>
    <div class="sym-select-name apply-c">@ 적용</div>
    <div class="sym-select-desc">삶에 적용하게 된 부분 — 머리로 아는 데서 그치지 않고</div>
    </div>
    </button>
    </div>
    </div>
    <div class="btn-row">
    <button class="btn btn-ghost" onclick="closeOv('sentOv')">취소</button>
    <button class="btn btn-green" id="sentBtn" onclick="submitSent()">올리기</button>
    </div>
    </div>
    </div>
    <!-- ══ 모달: 모임준비 입력 ══ -->
    <div class="ov" id="prepOv">
    <div class="msheet">
    <div class="mhandle"></div>
    <div class="mtitle" id="prepOvTitle">모임 준비</div>
    <div id="prepAlert"></div>
    <div class="fg"><label>이름</label>
    <select id="prepName"><option value="">이름 선택</option></select></div>
    <div class="fg"><label id="prepTextLabel">내용</label>
    <textarea id="prepText" rows="4"></textarea></div>
    <div class="fg"><label>페이지 (선택)</label>
    <input type="number" id="prepPage" placeholder="예: 47"/></div>
    <div class="btn-row">
    <button class="btn btn-ghost" onclick="closeOv('prepOv')">취소</button>
    <button class="btn btn-green" id="prepBtn" onclick="submitPrep()">올리기</button>
    </div>
    </div>
    </div>
    <!-- ══ 모달: 레퍼런스 ══ -->
    <div class="ov" id="refOv">
    <div class="msheet">
    <div class="mhandle"></div>
    <div class="mtitle">📎 레퍼런스 추가</div>
    <div id="refAlert"></div>
    <div class="fg"><label>이름</label>
    <select id="rfName"><option value="">이름 선택</option></select></div>
    <div class="fg"><label>제목</label>
    <input id="rfTitle" type="text" placeholder="제목 입력"/></div>
    <div class="fg"><label>URL</label>
    <input id="rfUrl" type="url" placeholder="https://..."/></div>
    <div class="fg"><label>종류</label>
    <select id="rfType">
    <option value="유튜브🎬">유튜브 🎬</option>
    <option value="기사📰">기사 📰</option>
    <option value="블로그✍️">블로그 ✍️</option>
    <option value="기타🔗">기타 🔗</option>
    </select>
    </div>
    <div class="btn-row">
    <button class="btn btn-ghost" onclick="closeOv('refOv')">취소</button>
    <button class="btn btn-green" id="refBtn" onclick="submitRef()">추가</button>
    </div>
    </div>
    </div>
    <!-- ══ 모달: FAB ══ -->
    <div class="ov" id="fabOv">
    <div class="msheet">
    <div class="mhandle"></div>
    <div class="mtitle">무엇을 올릴까요? 🦕</div>
    <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px">
    <button class="btn btn-green" onclick="closeOv('fabOv');openOv('sentOv')">💬 구절 올리기</button>
    <button class="btn btn-ghost" onclick="closeOv('fabOv');openOv('refOv')">📎 레퍼런스 추가</button>
    <button class="btn btn-ghost" onclick="closeOv('fabOv')">취소</button>
    </div>
    </div>
    </div>
    <script type="module">
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // 🦕 공룡 에이트 — Firebase Firestore 연동
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    import { initializeApp } from 'https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/11.0.0/firebase-app.js';
    import { getFirestore, collection, doc,
    addDoc, setDoc, getDoc, getDocs,
    query, where, orderBy, onSnapshot,
    serverTimestamp, Timestamp } from 'https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/11.0.0/firebase-firestore.js';
    // ── Firebase 설정 ────────────────────────────────────
    const firebaseConfig = {
    apiKey: 'AIzaSyApeN8utJH3RznsZqRs4VAExl0UnNpAvKg',
    authDomain: 'gongnyong8-c2f22.firebaseapp.com',
    projectId: 'gongnyong8-c2f22',
    storageBucket: 'gongnyong8-c2f22.firebasestorage.app',
    messagingSenderId: '514587455716',
    appId: '1:514587455716:web:5ccbb511655ca9f762fcf1'
    };
    const app = initializeApp(firebaseConfig);
    const db = getFirestore(app);
    // ── 멤버 & 부호 ──────────────────────────────────────
    const MEMBERS = ['박용희','강지혜','김양우','남우현','서수정','이정은','최별님','Ellory Park'];
    const SYMBOLS = {
    '!': { label:'! 느낌표', icon:'❗', cls:'bang', desc:'책을 처음 접하고 느낀 점 — 표지나 제목, 첫인상을 가볍게' },
    '"': { label:'" " 따옴표', icon:'💬', cls:'quote', desc:'인용하고 싶은 문장 — 읽으며 좋았던, 인사이트가 있었던 문장' },
    '?': { label:'? 물음표', icon:'❓', cls:'qmark', desc:'읽으며 궁금했던 것 — 몰라서, 의아해서, 질문이 생긴 것' },
    '@': { label:'@ 적용', icon:'✨', cls:'apply', desc:'삶에 적용하게 된 부분 — 머리로 아는 데서 그치지 않고' },
    };
    // ── 상태 ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    let selSyms = [];
    let curFilter = 'all';
    let curPrepSym = null;
    let allSentences = [];
    let sentUnsubscribers = {}; // 실시간 댓글 리스너
    const thisMonth = () => new Date().toLocaleDateString('sv-SE').slice(0, 7); // 'YYYY-MM'
    const todayStr = () => new Date().toLocaleDateString('sv-SE');
    const fmtD = s => s ? String(s).slice(5).replace('-', '/') : '';
    const esc = s => String(s)
    .replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;').replace(/\n/g,'<br>');
    const q = sel => document.querySelector(sel);
    // ── 초기화 ───────────────────────────────────────────
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    fillSelects();
    loadHome();
    setupOverlayClose();
    });
    function fillSelects() {
    ['olName','stName','rfName','prepName'].forEach(id => {
    const sel = q(`#${id}`);
    if (!sel) return;
    MEMBERS.forEach(m => { sel.innerHTML += `<option value="${m}">${m}</option>`; });
    });
    }
    function setupOverlayClose() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.ov').forEach(ov => {
    ov.addEventListener('click', e => { if (e.target === ov) ov.classList.remove('on'); });
    });
    }
    // ── 탭 이동 ──────────────────────────────────────────
    async function goTab(tab) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.screen').forEach(s => s.classList.remove('on'));
    document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
    q(`#sc${tab}`).classList.add('on');
    const btn = document.querySelector(`[data-sc="${tab}"]`);
    if (btn) btn.classList.add('active');
    if (tab === 'Home') loadHome();
    if (tab === 'Sent') loadSentences();
    if (tab === 'Prep') loadPrep();
    if (tab === 'Ref') loadRefs();
    if (tab === 'Arch') loadArchive();
    }
    window.goTab = goTab;
    // ══ 홈 ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
    async function loadHome() {
    await Promise.all([loadMeeting(), loadBook(), loadOneliners()]);
    }
    // ── 모임 설정 ────────────────────────────────────────
    async function loadMeeting() {
    const snap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'settings', 'meeting'));
    if (!snap.exists()) return;
    const m = snap.data();
    const today = new Date(); today.setHours(0,0,0,0);
    const meet = new Date(m.date); meet.setHours(0,0,0,0);
    const diff = Math.round((meet - today) / 86400000);
    const card = q('#ddayCard');
    if (diff > 0) q('#ddayNum').textContent = 'D-' + diff;
    else if (diff === 0){ q('#ddayNum').textContent = 'D-DAY 🎉'; card.style.background='#e67e22'; }
    else q('#ddayNum').textContent = '모임 완료';
    q('#ddayDate').textContent = `${m.date}${m.location?' · '+m.location:''}${m.note?' · '+m.note:''}`;
    q('#mtDate').value = m.date || '';
    q('#mtLoc').value = m.location || '';
    q('#mtNote').value = m.note || '';
    }
    async function saveMeeting() {
    const date = q('#mtDate').value;
    if (!date) { flash('meetingAlert','날짜를 선택해주세요.','e'); return; }
    setLoad('meetingSaveBtn', true, '저장 중...');
    try {
    await setDoc(doc(db, 'settings', 'meeting'), {
    date, location: q('#mtLoc').value.trim(), note: q('#mtNote').value.trim(),
    updatedAt: serverTimestamp()
    });
    closeOv('meetingOv');
    await loadMeeting();
    } catch(e) { flash('meetingAlert','오류: '+e.message,'e'); }
    finally { setLoad('meetingSaveBtn', false, '저장'); }
    }
    window.saveMeeting = saveMeeting;
    // ── 책 설정 ──────────────────────────────────────────
    async function loadBook() {
    const snap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'settings', 'book_' + thisMonth()));
    const el = q('#bookArea');
    if (!snap.exists()) {
    el.innerHTML = `<div class="card" style="text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;padding:20px">🦕 이달의 책을 설정해주세요</div>`;
    return;
    }
    const b = snap.data();
    ['bkTitle','bkAuthor','bkPub','bkPrice','bkCover','bkIntro','bkLink'].forEach(id => {
    const field = { bkTitle:'title',bkAuthor:'author',bkPub:'publisher',bkPrice:'price',
    bkCover:'coverUrl',bkIntro:'intro',bkLink:'link' }[id];
    if (q(`#${id}`)) q(`#${id}`).value = b[field] || '';
    });
    el.innerHTML = `
    <div class="book-card">
    ${b.coverUrl
    ? `<img class="book-cover" src="${b.coverUrl}" alt="표지" onerror="this.style.display='none'">`
    : `<div class="book-cover-ph">🦕</div>`}
    <div style="flex:1;min-width:0">
    <div class="book-title">${esc(b.title)}</div>
    <div class="book-author">${esc(b.author||'')}${b.publisher?' · '+esc(b.publisher):''}</div>
    ${b.price?`<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)">${esc(b.price)}</div>`:''}
    ${b.intro?`<div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:6px;line-height:1.6">${esc(b.intro)}</div>`:''}
    ${b.link?`<a href="${b.link}" target="_blank" style="font-size:12px;color:var(--accent);display:inline-block;margin-top:5px">책 정보 →</a>`:''}
    </div>
    </div>`;
    }
    async function saveBook() {
    const title = q('#bkTitle').value.trim();
    if (!title) { flash('bookAlert','제목을 입력해주세요.','e'); return; }
    setLoad('bookSaveBtn', true, '저장 중...');
    try {
    await setDoc(doc(db, 'settings', 'book_' + thisMonth()), {
    month: thisMonth(), title,
    author: q('#bkAuthor').value.trim(),
    publisher: q('#bkPub').value.trim(),
    price: q('#bkPrice').value.trim(),
    coverUrl: q('#bkCover').value.trim(),
    intro: q('#bkIntro').value.trim(),
    link: q('#bkLink').value.trim(),
    updatedAt: serverTimestamp()
    });
    closeOv('bookOv');
    await loadBook();
    } catch(e) { flash('bookAlert','오류: '+e.message,'e'); }
    finally { setLoad('bookSaveBtn', false, '저장'); }
    }
    window.saveBook = saveBook;
    // ── 한마디 ───────────────────────────────────────────
    async function loadOneliners() {
    const q_ = query(collection(db, 'oneliners'), where('month','==',thisMonth()));
    const snap = await getDocs(q_);
    const map = {};
    snap.forEach(d => { map[d.data().memberName] = d.data().comment; });
    const el = q('#onelineGrid');
    el.innerHTML = MEMBERS.map(m => `
    <div class="oneliner-card">
    <div class="ol-name">${m}</div>
    ${map[m]
    ? `<div class="ol-text">${esc(map[m])}</div>`
    : `<div class="ol-empty">아직 한마디 없음</div>`}
    </div>`).join('');
    }
    function openOnelineModal() { q('#olText').value=''; q('#olAlert').innerHTML=''; openOv('onelineOv'); }
    window.openOnelineModal = openOnelineModal;
    async function submitOneline() {
    const name = q('#olName').value, text = q('#olText').value.trim();
    if (!name || !text) { flash('olAlert','이름과 한마디를 입력해주세요.','e'); return; }
    setLoad('olBtn', true, '등록 중...');
    try {
    // 같은 달 같은 멤버 → upsert
    await setDoc(doc(db, 'oneliners', thisMonth() + '_' + name), {
    month: thisMonth(), memberName: name, comment: text,
    date: todayStr(), updatedAt: serverTimestamp()
    });
    closeOv('onelineOv');
    await loadOneliners();
    } catch(e) { flash('olAlert','오류: '+e.message,'e'); }
    finally { setLoad('olBtn', false, '등록'); }
    }
    window.submitOneline = submitOneline;
    // ══ 구절 ═════════════════════════════════════════════
    async function loadSentences() {
    const el = q('#sentList');
    el.innerHTML = `<div class="empty"><div class="ei">🦕</div>불러오는 중...</div>`;
    try {
    const q_ = query(
    collection(db, 'sentences'),
    where('month','==',thisMonth()),
    orderBy('createdAt','desc')
    );
    const snap = await getDocs(q_);
    allSentences = [];
    snap.forEach(d => allSentences.push({ id: d.id, ...d.data() }));
    renderSentences();
    } catch(e) {
    el.innerHTML = `<div class="empty"><div class="ei">⚠️</div>${e.message}</div>`;
    }
    }
    function filterSent(sym, btn) {
    curFilter = sym;
    document.querySelectorAll('.ftab').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
    btn.classList.add('active');
    renderSentences();
    }
    window.filterSent = filterSent;
    function renderSentences() {
    const el = q('#sentList');
    const list = curFilter === 'all'
    ? allSentences
    : allSentences.filter(s => (s.tags||'').split(',').includes(curFilter));
    if (!list.length) {
    el.innerHTML = `<div class="empty"><div class="ei">🦕</div>${curFilter==='all'?'아직 공유된 구절이 없어요':'이 부호의 구절이 없어요'}</div>`;
    return;
    }
    el.innerHTML = list.map(s => {
    const tags = (s.tags||'').split(',').filter(Boolean);
    const primarySym = tags[0];
    const borderCls = primarySym ? `sym-${SYMBOLS[primarySym]?.cls||''}-card` : '';
    return `
    <div class="sc ${borderCls}" id="sc-${s.id}">
    <div class="sc-hd">
    <div class="avatar">${s.memberName[0]}</div>
    <div>
    <div class="sc-name">${esc(s.memberName)}</div>
    <div class="sc-date">${fmtD(s.date)}</div>
    </div>
    <div style="margin-left:auto;display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end">
    ${tags.map(t => symBadge(t)).join('')}
    </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sc-sent">${esc(s.sentence)}</div>
    ${s.page?`<div class="sc-pg">p. ${s.page}</div>`:''}
    <div class="sc-ft">
    <button class="cmt-btn" onclick="toggleThread('${s.id}')">
    💬 <span id="cmt-count-${s.id}">${s.commentCount>0?s.commentCount+'개 댓글':'댓글 달기'}</span>
    </button>
    </div>
    <div class="cmt-thread" id="thread-${s.id}" style="display:none">
    <div id="cmts-${s.id}"></div>
    <div class="cmt-input-row">
    <select id="cname-${s.id}">${MEMBERS.map(m=>`<option value="${m}">${m}</option>`).join('')}</select>
    <input type="text" id="cinput-${s.id}" placeholder="댓글을 남겨보세요"
    onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter')submitCmt('${s.id}')"/>
    <button class="cmt-send" onclick="submitCmt('${s.id}')">↑</button>
    </div>
    </div>
    </div>`;
    }).join('');
    }
    async function toggleThread(sid) {
    const thread = q(`#thread-${sid}`);
    const isOpen = thread.style.display !== 'none';
    if (isOpen) {
    thread.style.display = 'none';
    // 리스너 해제
    if (sentUnsubscribers[sid]) { sentUnsubscribers[sid](); delete sentUnsubscribers[sid]; }
    } else {
    thread.style.display = 'block';
    subscribeComments(sid);
    }
    }
    window.toggleThread = toggleThread;
    // 실시간 댓글 리스너
    function subscribeComments(sid) {
    if (sentUnsubscribers[sid]) return; // 이미 구독 중
    const q_ = query(
